note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a New Castle County building permit for Arden property when required
items.authority: State of Delaware Business First Steps / New Castle County
items.description: Delaware’s local business guide directs Arden applicants to the applicable county and municipal permit process; building permits for Arden are handled through New Castle County rather than a separate village building official.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain an Ardencroft tree-removal permit when required
items.description: Ardencroft requires leaseholders to obtain a tree permit before removing a tree, and the village association must approve building construction permits.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain New Castle County building permits for Ardentown work when required
items.authority: Village of Ardentown / New Castle County Department of Land Use
items.description: Ardentown directs building, demolition, and renovation permits through New Castle County; the county may request approval of plans from the Ardentown Trustees.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Follow Bellefonte building-permit requirements
items.description: Bellefonte’s charter authorizes the town to regulate construction and require building permits for covered building or construction work.

items.title: Renew your Bethany Beach business license
items.description: A business in Bethany Beach needs a town license, issued from June 1 to May 31 for $250 a year, and it can be bought for one, two or three years. A license holder in good standing can renew online by card. A rental license costs $100 a year for each unit rented, and the real estate rental tax is 7% of gross rental receipts, paid twice a year. The town's fiscal 2026 schedule charges a $100 administrative fee for not getting the license by the renewal date.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Bethel, Delaware building permit when required
items.description: Bethel requires a town building permit for covered construction and modifications; new homes generally require the Sussex County permit before the town permit, while other applications are processed by the town first.

items.title: Renew your Blades business license
items.description: The Town of Blades fee schedule effective August 12, 2024 charges $100.00 for a general services business license, $200.00 for a rental license on an apartment, cottage or house of one or two bedrooms, and $100.00 for an office or building rental.

note: The Town's charter lets the council fix business license fees, but no fee schedule was found.

items.title: Obtain a Bowers Beach permit when required
items.description: Bowers Beach requires applicants for new construction, substantial improvements, garages, sheds, decks, and fences to contact the town’s zoning compliance officer for the applicable permit process.

items.title: Renew your Bridgeville business license
items.description: Every business in Bridgeville fills in the town's yearly business license application, with a copy of its Delaware business license and a certificate of liability insurance. The annual fee is $100, but a business physically inside the town limits does not have to pay it. Payment is online at the town's site and the documents go to the town by email.

items.title: Renew your Camden business license
items.description: A business in Camden applies each year under Ordinance 2007-104 for a license for the period ending December 31, naming the number of people employed and whether the business is commercial or residential. The application needs a copy of the State of Delaware business license and a certificate of insurance naming the Town of Camden as certificate holder. The form shows no fee.

items.title: Renew your Cheswold business license
items.description: A business in Cheswold needs a town license renewed every year, with the initial fee paid with the application and renewals at the same rates. The town's schedule, revised February 3, 2025, charges $100 for a bar, restaurant, auto repair or day care of 1 to 5 children, $65 for a one-chair barber or beauty shop plus $15 per extra chair, $120 for retail and grocery up to 3,000 square feet, $150 for auto sales, $175 for accounting, $200 for a commercial contractor, $300 for each attorney and $500 for a bank or gas station, among other types. Mobile home parks of 35 or fewer homes are exempt, and some fees are not listed.

items.title: Renew your Clayton business license
items.description: A business with a building in Clayton needs a town license for $75, valid through December 31, and a renewal received after January 31 carries a late fee and penalty. A contractor, meaning any business outside town limits, pays $125 for a license valid 12 months from issue and must show liability insurance naming the town ($500,000 residential, $1,000,000 commercial). A mobile food vendor pays $25, and a solicitor $100 plus $25 for each person soliciting. All debts owed to the town must be paid before a license is approved.

items.title: Renew your Dagsboro business license
items.description: Resident merchants, outside contractors and rentals in Dagsboro renew their town licenses by January 1, and a late payment costs $45 for each license. The town's renewal notice gives no base fee, so ask the town office at 302-732-3777.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Renew a Delaware City business license
items.description: Delaware City requires a valid city business license for businesses operating in the city, including mobile and transient businesses; the 2026 application covers January 1 through December 31.

items.title: Obtain a Delaware City building permit when required
items.authority: City of Delaware City Planning and Zoning
items.description: Delaware City requires a building subcode permit and then a city building permit for covered construction or alteration; commercial property also requires State Fire Marshal approval before the building-permit application.

items.title: Renew your Delmar business license
items.description: Every person who carries on a business in Delmar needs a town license for the license year February 1 to January 31, reviewed by the Planning & Zoning Director. The fee is $50 for a business inside the town limits and $75 for one outside, and the application needs copies of all state and county licenses and permits that apply to the business.

items.title: Renew your Dewey Beach business license
items.description: A business in Dewey Beach needs a town license for each license year, which runs May 1 to April 30; the 2026 renewals cover May 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Existing businesses renew through the town's online payment portal, new ones apply online or at Town Hall, and a one-day business license costs $27. The town's page does not list the annual fees.

items.title: Pay the City of Dover business license fee
items.authority: City of Dover Department of Planning and Inspections
items.description: A business working in Dover needs a city license, valid August 1 to July 31, and one bought after July is prorated by the months left. The fee depends on the type of business, set by ordinance 2024-22: for example $128 for an eating establishment, $180 for a food truck, $192 for a car wash or fitness trainer, $320 for each attorney, dentist or physician, and $52 to $320 for other businesses by employee count. Manufacturers and contractors pay $0.00046 of gross receipts with a $128 minimum, and merchants and bottlers the same rate on purchases for resale with a $64 minimum. A renewal not paid by August 31 adds a penalty of 10% of the fee for each month.

items.title: Get your Ellendale business license
items.description: Anyone doing work within Ellendale town limits, including construction, lawn care, heating and air, surveying, tree work, plumbing, painting, cable and TV services and repairs, and anyone placing advertising signs in town, needs a town business license on top of the state license. The fee is $125.00 per calendar year with no proration, and the application needs a copy of the Delaware state license and liability insurance.

items.title: Renew your Elsmere business license
items.description: A business in Elsmere, or one working for the town, needs a town license for the period November 1 to October 31. The fee is $150 for a general contractor or any other business and $125 for a subcontractor. The application needs a copy of any State of Delaware or New Castle County license and proof of business insurance, and fees are doubled for a business that operates before getting the license.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain Farmington, Delaware municipal approval before a Kent County building permit when required
items.authority: Town of Farmington / Kent County Levy Court
items.description: Kent County identifies Farmington among the municipalities requiring a town permit or letter of approval before the county issues a building permit.

items.title: Get a Felton contractor's license
items.description: A contractor working in Felton needs a town contractor's license, which costs $100 on the town's fee schedule for July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026, applied for with a copy of the Delaware business license and a certificate of liability insurance. The town takes license payments through its online portal, and its pages show no fee for a general business license.

items.title: Obtain a Felton building permit when required
items.authority: Town of Felton / Kent County Division of Permitting and Enforcement
items.description: Felton requires building permits for most construction within town limits; the town generally issues a zoning compliance letter that must accompany the application to Kent County for the official building permit.

items.title: Get your Fenwick Island business license
items.description: A business or landlord in Fenwick Island needs a town license for each calendar year, obtained before opening or continuing business. The fiscal 2026-2027 fees are $185 plus $0.10 per square foot of floor space plus a $60 EMS fee for a retail merchant, $75 for a contractor earning under $1,500 in town and $200 above that, $185 for a rental landlord (plus $7.20 per sleeping unit for motels and hotels), and $25 to $250 per vending machine depending on its type. Late payment of the fee costs $100.

items.title: Renew your Frankford business license
items.description: A business in Frankford needs a town license, which costs $75.00 and is valid for one year, from January 1 through December 31. Failing to get one may bring a $150.00 penalty and a stop work order, and the application asks for the Delaware state license number.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Renew a Frederica business license
items.description: Frederica’s fee schedule lists an annual business license and the town provides a business-license application.

items.title: Obtain a Frederica building permit when required
items.description: Frederica’s fee schedule lists building permits and the town publishes a building permit application through its forms and reports page.

items.title: Get a Georgetown business license
items.description: A person or company doing business within Georgetown town limits needs a town business license under Chapter 130 of the town code. The cost varies with the type and location of the business, with fees set in Chapter 98, and the application is at the Planning Department on The Circle or on the town's website. A Delaware state business license from the Division of Revenue is also needed.

items.title: Renew your Greenwood business license
items.description: A business in Greenwood needs a town license for the calendar year. The 2026 fee schedule charges $75 for a resident business and $150 for a non-resident one, $25 for a peddler or solicitor, and $100 per unit for a rental license. The schedule file is marked as proposed on December 10, 2025.

items.title: Renew your Harrington business license
items.description: Anyone selling goods or services in Harrington, including retail, wholesale, service, rental, food service and professional activity, must get a city license before opening, and it must be renewed every July. A business located in the city needs a business license and one outside the city limits needs a contractor license, and rental properties are licensed separately. Utilities, charitable or religious activities (except retail), exhibitors and yard sales are exempt. The city's page lists no fees, so call the Business Office at 302-398-3530.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Hartly building permit when required
items.authority: Town of Hartly Public Works Commissioner
items.description: Hartly requires an application for a building construction, alteration, or demolition permit under its building and general construction ordinance.

items.title: Get your Henlopen Acres business license
items.description: Anyone selling merchandise or providing services for profit in Henlopen Acres, contractors and subcontractors included, needs a town business license for the calendar year, with no proration. The 2025-2026 schedule charges $50.00 for a business of up to 5 employees, $175.00 for 6 or more, and $275.00 for a business using trucks over 26,000 pounds.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Houston, Delaware business license
items.description: Houston provides a town business-license application for businesses operating in the town.

items.title: Obtain a Houston, Delaware building permit when required
items.description: Houston provides a town building-permit application for covered construction work.

note: Council minutes from December 2019 say the Town tabled business licenses; no current business license or fee was found.

items.title: Obtain a Kenton building permit when required
items.description: Kenton publishes a building permit application for covered work and requires the supporting plans and Kent County documentation identified on the form.

items.title: Get a Laurel business license
items.description: A business opening in Laurel needs a town business license, obtained after the Delaware state business license, the pre-development meeting with the Code Enforcement Officer, and final inspection and approval. The town's guide gives no fee, and the application is on its website. Depending on the business, approvals from DelDOT, the State Fire Marshal, Sussex County, the Division of Public Health or DNREC may also be needed.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Leipsic permit permission letter when required
items.authority: Town of Leipsic Planning Commission and Town Council
items.description: Leipsic requires a permit permission letter for new builds and repairs requiring a Kent County building permit before the owner applies to the county; letters are valid for one year.

items.title: Renew your Lewes business license
items.description: Anyone engaged for profit within Lewes city limits pays an annual license fee for the calendar year, and a new license obtained in October, November or December costs half. The April 2025 schedule charges $108 for a rental, commercial rental, restaurant-space or parking lot, $135 for a barber, beauty parlor or dry cleaner, $190 for an insurance agent, food service business, medical or other professional, $163 for retail up to 2,500 square feet and $300 for 2,501 to 5,000, $218 for a restaurant that does not serve alcohol and $410 for one that does, $465 for a bank, $150 for a contractor with 1 to 5 employees and $360 for 6 or more, and $245 for manufacturing.

items.title: Get a Lewes rental license
items.description: Each residential rental unit in Lewes, short-term or long-term, needs a city rental license, which costs $200 a year. A second violation notice costs $250 and a third $500 with the rental license suspended for 12 months.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Little Creek building and floodplain permit when required
items.description: Little Creek publishes a building and floodplain permit application and charges a $50 building permit fee effective April 1, 2025.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Magnolia building permit when required
items.description: Magnolia requires a construction or building permit before building or adding to a structure; the town permit is then submitted to Kent County for the county permit and is valid for one year.

items.title: Renew your Middletown business license
items.authority: Town of Middletown Permits, Licensing & Inspections
items.description: Every business located in Middletown, and every contractor working within the town, needs a town business license, renewed by February 15. The fee depends on the kind of business: $135 for a construction, retail-service, administrative, educational or one-or-two-person personal care business, $275 for professional, finance, health care or larger daycare businesses, and $5.50 per space for a mobile home park. Manufacturers, retailers, wholesalers and bottlers instead pay $0.00046 on gross receipts above $400,000, with a $135 minimum, or $50 if gross receipts are under $100,000 and the town gets a letter by February 15. Payments after February 15 pay a penalty of 1% a month and a $100 failure to file fee.

items.title: Get a Milford business license
items.authority: City of Milford Planning & Economic Development
items.description: A business with a physical location in Milford must hold a city business license from the Planning & Economic Development Department, and residential rentals need a rental license for the calendar year January 1 to December 31. The city's FAQ gives no fee, and applications go through its permits and licenses portal.

items.title: Renew your Millsboro business license
items.description: A business in Millsboro needs a town license for the calendar year, which costs $50.00, and renewals must match the name and address on the renewal letter exactly. Rental registration costs $25 per motel room, $35 per apartment and $65 per single-family or townhouse unit, and mobile food vendors and single-day vendors have their own forms.

items.title: Renew your Millville business license
items.description: A business in Millville needs a town license, which runs with the town's fiscal year, May 1 to April 30. The fee is $100, renewal invoices are mailed around May 1 and are due June 1, and an invoice not paid by June 1 adds a $50 late fee. A license bought after November 1 costs $50 and a temporary license of up to 30 days $25. The application needs a copy of the Delaware state business license, and contractors also need proof of liability insurance in the business's name.

note: The Town's fee schedule says business and rental licenses are required annually and points to a separate schedule that could not be read.

items.title: Obtain a Milton, Delaware business license
items.description: Milton provides an application for a town business license and routes new-business applicants through the town’s business-start process.

items.title: Obtain a Milton, Delaware building permit when required
items.description: Milton provides a building permit application for construction work and uses town and outside-agency inspections before business opening when a building permit is required.

items.title: Renew your City of New Castle business license
items.description: A business in the City of New Castle needs a new city license each year, with the fee set by headcount including the owner and counting all employees wherever they work: $50 for 1 to 3, $90 for 4 to 8, $210 for 9 to 20 and $360 for 21 or more. An application received after February 1 adds a late charge of 10% a month. The city can also require a surety bond under its code, and the Building Official can waive it for low-risk businesses.

items.title: Obtain a City of Newark business license
items.description: A business license is required for businesses operating in the City of Newark, Delaware. Fees are set from estimates of the demand and cost of municipal services related to business activity, under Chapter 13, Article VII of the City Code (section 13-43 and following). The page read gives no amount or renewal date.

items.title: Get a Newark rental license
items.authority: City of Newark Planning and Development
items.description: A landlord renting in Newark needs a rental license for each unit. The 2026 fees are $234 per unit in a single-family or two-family home, $160 per townhouse or condominium unit, $86 per unit in buildings of three or more units, and $49 per occupant in fraternities, sororities and boarding houses. A bill paid late adds 5% and then 1.5% a month, and a $5 technology fee applies to every business and rental license.

items.title: Get Newark contractor and fire licenses
items.authority: City of Newark Planning and Development
items.description: The 2026 Newark fee schedule charges $100 for a contractor's license, $50 for an elevator license, and $100 a year for a fire license. Fire safety registration is $100 per registration and each fire alarm or suppression system report $25. Annual sign fees are $1.25 per square foot with a $55 minimum.

items.title: Get a Newport business license
items.description: Every business located in Newport, and every outside contractor working in the town, needs a town business license on top of the state license, and owners who lease commercial or residential property need a renter's license. The town posts a 2026 application and fee schedule, which could not be read here. Structural, plumbing, mechanical and electrical permits cost $11 for the first $1,000 of job value and $6 for each additional $1,000, with a $50 minimum.

items.title: Get your Ocean View business and rental licenses
items.description: Anyone performing a job in Ocean View needs a town business license, which follows the calendar year and costs $200 for a full year. Anyone renting property in the town also needs a $150 yearly rental license, and a gross rental receipts tax is due to the town twice a year.

note: The Town's building permits page says contractors do not need an Odessa business license, but a copy of the state license may be asked for; no general business license fee was found.

items.title: Obtain an Odessa building permit when required
items.description: Odessa requires applicable building, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, zoning, and historic-review permits before covered work starts; all permit applications are submitted to the town for approval and inspection.

items.title: Renew your Rehoboth Beach business license
items.authority: City of Rehoboth Beach Building & Licensing Department
items.description: Every business inside Rehoboth Beach city limits, and every contractor or company providing products or services within the city, must hold a current city business license from the Building & Licensing Department. Renewal needs a copy of the current Delaware business license and a certificate of liability insurance naming the city as certificate holder, and residential rentals, outdoor dining on public space and restaurants have their own licenses or permits. A Restaurant Permit of Compliance application costs $1,000. The city's pages show no business license fee table; call 302-227-6181.

note: The City says a business with a store in Seaford must hold a business license, but no application or fee was on a page that could be read.

items.title: Maintain a valid Seaford business license
items.description: Seaford’s official business materials require a physical business within the corporate limits to hold a valid business license, and the city code requires applicable city licensing for regulated business activities.

items.title: Get a Selbyville business license
items.description: Under an ordinance passed May 1, 2023, anyone without an establishment in Selbyville who sells merchandise, provides services, rents units or serves food within town limits must hold a town business license, and businesses inside the town are licensed under the town code too. The town's page gives no fee or term, so ask Town Hall.

note: The Town's charter lets the council fix annual business license fees, but no fee schedule was found.

items.title: Obtain a Slaughter Beach building permit when required
items.description: Slaughter Beach requires a town building permit for covered construction and issues it after a complete application, required documentation, and payment of the permit fee.

items.title: Get and renew a Smyrna business license
items.description: Any business that sells goods or services from a location in Smyrna must be licensed and registered before it opens, and licenses are for the calendar year. The 2026 fee schedule charges $125 per location for most businesses, $250 for each architect, attorney, accountant, dentist, physician, engineer and similar professional, for banks and loan agencies and for daycares over six children, and $125 for the first two barbers or beauticians. A business outside town limits that works in Smyrna needs a $125 contractor license, and a peddler or solicitor $125. The town's page does not give a renewal date.

items.title: Get a Smyrna rental license
items.description: A landlord who rents out property in Smyrna needs a rental license, which costs $100 in 2026, plus a $75 rental inspection and $100 for any re-inspection.

items.title: Renew your South Bethany mercantile license
items.description: A business working in South Bethany needs a mercantile license for each calendar year, which costs $200 for the full year. The application needs a check to the town, a copy of the Delaware state business license and a certificate of liability insurance. Construction is not allowed on Sundays or federal holidays.

items.title: Renew your Townsend business license
items.description: Businesses in Townsend pay their license fee by February 15 each year, and a late payment accrues a penalty of 10% a month, with each day a separate violation. Under the May 2026 schedule most businesses pay $130, professionals such as architects, attorneys, accountants, dentists and physicians $255 each, and gas, power, cable and telephone companies $830. Manufacturers pay 0.00046 of gross receipts over $400,000 (minimum $130) and merchants and bottlers 0.00046 of purchases for resale over $400,000 (minimum $750), or $125 if under $100,000 with a letter to the town by January 31.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Viola building permit when required
items.authority: Town of Viola / Kent County Division of Permitting and Enforcement
items.description: Viola requires building permits for most construction within town limits; the town issues a compliance letter that must be taken to Kent County for the official permit.

items.title: Obtain a City of Wilmington business license
items.authority: City of Wilmington Finance Department, Wage and Business License Division
items.description: Businesses operating within Wilmington need a Delaware state business license and also a city business license; the city application asks for a copy of the state license. Some trades (heating, plumbing, air conditioning) must pass a trade test with the Department of Licenses and Inspections first, and restaurants must supply a Board of Health certificate. The fee and renewal date were not stated on the pages read.

note: The State's list of city and town licensing links no business license application for this municipality, and no page on one was found.

items.title: Obtain a Woodside building permit when required
items.authority: Town of Woodside / Kent County Office of Inspections and Enforcement
items.description: Woodside requires town approval and a Kent County building permit for new construction and major structural improvements; commercial projects may also require a business certificate of occupancy.

items.title: Renew your Wyoming business license
items.description: A business with a physical address in Wyoming needs a town license each year, with the fee set by headcount: $108.75 for 1 to 6 employees, $181.25 for 7 to 12, $253.75 for 13 to 18, $326.25 for 19 to 24 and $398.75 for 25 or more. A non-resident contractor pays $145.00 a year, and a landlord pays $145.00 a year for the first rental unit plus $36.00 for each additional unit, with an $85.00 rental inspection before a rental certificate of occupancy. An unpaid balance accrues interest of 10% a month after the license expires.
